# Skibsaktie gav Jakob Have 1000 pct. i afkast på én dag: “Markedet overså en kæmpe mulighed”

**Feed**: borsen-podcast  
**Published**: 2026-07-08  
**Market Sentiment**: Mixed

⏱️ **Time Horizon Key**: ST = <3 months | MT = 3-12 months | LT = >12 months

---

## Episode Thesis

A special summer edition of Børsen Investor Podcast featuring activist value-investor Jakob Have of Nordic Compound Invest, who runs a concentrated 8-12 stock portfolio (330M DKK) in small/mid-cap Nordic and First North companies. He explains his deep-value, high-conviction, control-oriented style: buying operationally sound but poorly-governed companies cheaply, then taking board seats to fix capital allocation. He details his large stake in Donkey Republic, a past tenbagger in Viking Supply Ships, holdings in Hove and Scandinavian Medical Solutions, and cautionary tales (Blue Vision/Pharma Equity Group) plus companies he avoids on principle (North Media, all biotech).

---

## Universe Stocks

### 🟢 DONKEY — Donkey Republic | **BUY** (Strong)

**Sentiment**: Positive | **Time Horizon**: LT  
**Confidence**: 85%

Fundamentally cheap First North bike-rental firm; won German city tenders giving 5-year exclusivity and stable forecasts; 80M EBITDA expected 2027 vs <300M market cap.

#### Reasoning

Have invested 50M DKK (Feb 2026), holds >20% and a board seat. New capital removes the balance-sheet constraint that stopped Donkey bidding on tenders. German municipal tenders provide five-year exclusivity, fixed fees and predictable minute-based revenue, giving a stable forecast base. He sees large unrecognized value uplift not yet reflected in the share price and rates it operationally on the right track.

#### Sell Triggers

- if German tender contracts are lost or not renewed
- if 2027 EBITDA target of ~80M is materially missed
- if management reverts to over-leverage limiting tender participation
- if platform/First North governance risk deteriorates

> *"Det gör att jag har riktigt stor komfort på att den utmälning omkring deras resultatförväntningar i 27, alltså 80 miljoner i BDA på något som nu kostar lite under 300 miljoner i marknadskap. Det syns jag är billigt."*
